Centromere regions for a bundled genome

Source: R/centromeres.R
load_centromeres.Rd

Returns the centromere (cytoband acen) span per chromosome from the bundled cytoband data. Used by call_simple_excision() to flag and exclude "chromosomal bridge" events – amplicons whose amplified edge terminates within a centromere (a dicentric / bridge signature) rather than forming a self-contained episome.

Usage

load_centromeres(genome = c("hg38", "hg19", "mm10"))

Arguments

genome

One of "hg38", "hg19", "mm10".

Value

A GenomicRanges::GRanges with one range per chromosome (the centromere span). Empty if the genome's cytobands carry no acen bands.

Examples

load_centromeres("hg38")
